title: Join a Live Match
summary: A spectator joins a live carrom match in progress and sees the board update in real time.
preconditions: A live match exists and is joinable

acceptance_criteria.title: Spectator joins successfully
acceptance_criteria.given: a live match is in progress
then: the user is added to the live viewer count

acceptance_criteria.title: Match ends while spectating
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is spectating a live match
then: the user sees a "Match complete" state
is offered a link to the results screen

edge_cases.title: Match becomes full mid-join
edge_cases.given: the match reaches max spectators as the user taps "Join"
then: the user sees a "Match is full" message

edge_cases.title: Network drops during join
then: the user sees a retry option
no partial join state is left behind

web.empty: "No live matches right now" with a refresh action
web.success: full board renders, live viewer count visible

ios.empty: same copy as web, platform-native empty-state illustration
